stories.title: Acampada en Sol por la vivienda, en directo | El Gobierno reconoce que va a ser “un lunes muy largo” de negociaciones para sacar adelante el decreto

en.title: Sol Encampment for Housing, Live | Government Acknowledges It Will Be a "Very Long Monday" of Negotiations to Push Through Decree
en.summary: Activists are camping at Sol in Madrid to protest housing conditions while the government negotiates a housing decree. Sumar warns that agreement on the decree text remains far off, and protests have spread to Barcelona.

stories.title: Los detalles del decreto de Moncloa sobre vivienda para convencer a sus socios

en.title: Details of the Moncloa Decree on Housing to Convince Its Partners
en.summary: The government plans to approve a housing decree on Tuesday aimed at addressing an emergency housing situation. The measure requires validation in Congress and must gain support from coalition partners including Sumar, Junts, and Podemos.

stories.title: Sumar advierte de que el acuerdo sobre el texto del real decreto de vivienda «sigue muy lejos»

en.title: Sumar Warns That Agreement on Housing Decree Text "Remains Far Off"
en.summary: Sumar, a government coalition partner, states that agreement on the housing decree planned for Tuesday remains distant. The party contends the decree must address specific issues including eviction protections, rental regulations, and tourist accommodation fraud.

stories.title: Acampada en Puerta del Sol de Madrid, la negociación del decreto de la vivienda y la última hora de desahucio de Maricarmen

en.title: Encampment at Puerta del Sol in Madrid, Housing Decree Negotiations, and Latest on Maricarmen's Eviction
en.summary: Approximately six hundred people remain encamped at Puerta del Sol protesting housing conditions following an incident-free night. Negotiations over a housing decree continue amid the broader housing crisis.

stories.title: El Gobierno cesará al delegado en Ceuta en el Consejo de Ministros de mañana

en.title: The Government will dismiss the delegate in Ceuta at tomorrow's Cabinet meeting
en.summary: Spain's government will remove its representative in Ceuta, who faced criticism over crisis management in the city. David de la Encina, former mayor of El Puerto de Santa María, will replace the current delegate.

stories.title: Vicente Vallés: «Moncloa necesita poner de acuerdo en un decreto sobre desahucios a Junts, en el lado derecho, y a Sumar y Podemos, en el lado izquierdo»

en.title: Vicente Vallés: "Moncloa needs to reach agreement in an eviction decree with Junts on the right and Sumar and Podemos on the left"
en.summary: A high-profile eviction case has sparked large protests in Madrid, with demonstrators demanding housing policy reforms. The government faces pressure to approve legislation including indefinite rental contracts while balancing support from ideologically diverse political parties.

stories.title: El delegado del Gobierno en Ceuta dimitirá en las próximas horas

en.title: The Government delegate in Ceuta will resign in the coming hours
en.summary: The government representative in Ceuta will submit his resignation, with the announcement expected to occur Monday. Officials attribute the departure to personal reasons following weeks of criticism over his management of the autonomous city.

stories.title: Desahucios, fondos buitre y bonificaciones: las medidas con las que Moncloa busca convencer a todos sus socios para apoyar el decreto sobre vivienda

en.title: Evictions, vulture funds and bonuses: the measures with which Moncloa seeks to convince all its allies to support the housing decree
en.summary: The government negotiates urgently to gain support from ideologically diverse political groups for housing legislation. The effort involves coordinating positions among left-wing and right-wing parties with conflicting priorities.

stories.title: Moncloa releva al delegado del Gobierno en Ceuta

en.title: Moncloa replaces government delegate in Ceuta
en.summary: Miguel Ángel Pérez Triano is being removed from his position as government delegate in Ceuta due to his handling of a crisis. His dismissal is expected to be confirmed at Tuesday's Cabinet meeting.

stories.title: El Gobierno prepara el relevo del delegado del Gobierno en Ceuta

en.title: Government prepares to replace government delegate in Ceuta
en.summary: Miguel Ángel Pérez Triano has communicated his desire to leave his position as government delegate in Ceuta, two months after a large wave of migrants entered the autonomous city.

stories.title: La rabia de los jóvenes por la vivienda activa la cuenta atrás en el reloj de Sol: 48 horas para un decreto real

en.title: Young people's anger over housing activates countdown at Sol clock: 48 hours for a royal decree
en.summary: Thousands of people are camping in central Madrid to pressure the government to approve housing legislation on Tuesday that will bring meaningful change.

stories.title: El delegado en Ceuta solicitó al Gobierno refuerzos ante el agravamiento de la presión migratoria una semana antes de la avalancha

en.title: Ceuta delegate requested Government reinforcements before migration pressure worsened a week before the surge
en.summary: Socialist Party members in Ceuta sought assistance from the Government starting July 28, reporting that the migrant situation was unsustainable and overwhelming.

stories.title: El Ibex hace frente al petróleo y a la IA

en.title: The Ibex faces oil and AI headwinds
en.summary: The Ibex index encounters renewed downward pressure from Asian and US markets weakened by slowing AI development, while Trump's rejection of Iran's ceasefire proposal pushes oil prices higher.

stories.title: Las imágenes del XVII Encuentro Financiero EXPANSIÓN-KPMG

en.title: Images from the XVII EXPANSIÓN-KPMG Financial Meeting
en.summary: Leaders from major banks and insurance companies gathered with supervisors and regulators at the EXPANSIÓN-KPMG Financial Meeting to discuss economic and financial challenges.

stories.title: Grisi (Santander): "La prioridad es el crecimiento orgánico, pero seremos flexibles para lograr la mayor rentabilidad"

en.title: Grisi (Santander): "Priority is organic growth, but we will be flexible to achieve greater profitability"
en.summary: Santander has paused acquisitions for two years to integrate Webster and TSB purchases, while remaining open to strategic opportunities that enhance profitability.

stories.title: La Fed intimida de nuevo al oro y al bitcoin

en.title: The Fed intimidates gold and bitcoin again
en.summary: Gold prices fell to seven-week lows and bitcoin declined, with the Federal Reserve serving as the common pressure factor on both assets.

stories.title: Las hipotecas sobre viviendas caen un 3,5% en julio: el dato marca un cambio de ciclo inmobiliario

en.title: Home mortgages fall 3.5% in July: data marks a real estate cycle shift
en.summary: July saw 43,372 home purchase mortgages signed, down 3.5% compared to the same month last year, signaling a change in the real estate cycle.
